result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of the repositories with commits in the past 90 days, not the 180-day figure.

The fix is one line in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java` (line 887). The LOC argument of the "past 90d" `addInfoBlock` call was `loc180Days`; it is now `loc90Days`, which was already computed correctly a few lines above. The count and percentage were already using the 90-day values.

The `reports` module compiles offline. No existing test covers this generator, so I did not exercise the output; the change is verified by reading the code only. I did not commit.
